notes: ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Οὐρίου: the outer substantival article governs no expressed head noun, so under rules 22, 31 and 102 it carries the antecedent pronoun, the supplied relativizer and copula, and the supplied nominal *the wife*, headed on the nominal.

The inner article is decided on its own phrase under rule 57's possessor-after-head clause: the ASV writes no determiner on *Uriah*, so rule 23 empties it and rule 21's determinerless clause leaves *of* with the name. Splitting *the wife* off onto τοῦ remains the competing reading.
